title: xtouch-daemon voice chat bridge
description: A line of the voice chat bridge between xtouch-daemon and a plugin of a voice chat client, one JSON object per line on the socket `$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/xtouch-daemon-voip.sock`. Both sides ignore keys they don't know.

Capability.description: What a provider can do besides telling who is there and who talks.
Capability.title: Capability

FromDaemon.description: A line of the daemon to the plugin.

FromPlugin.description: A line of the plugin to the daemon.

Greeting.description: The first line of the daemon to a plugin that connects.

version.description: The version of the daemon, e.g. `0.2.0`.
version.title: Version

protocol.description:
The version of the protocol that the daemon speaks. A plugin that speaks an older one can tell from it whether
the daemon understands it.
protocol.title: Protocol

Greeting.title: Greeting

MuteChange.description: The mute that Mute sets for a participant.

id.description: The `id` of the participant, as text.
id.title: Id

muted.description: True mutes the participant for the user, false unmutes them.
muted.title: Muted

MuteChange.title: MuteChange

ParticipantState.description: A participant of the voice chat, as the plugin knows them.

id.description:
What the client knows the participant by. It stays the same while they are there. A number is taken as text: the
commands of the daemon send it back as a string.
id.title: Id

name.description: The name of the participant: the LCD shows it, and the daemon keeps volume and mute by it.
name.title: Name

talking.description: The participant talks right now: the LCD lights in `talking_color`.
talking.title: Talking

muted.description: The user muted the participant, for themselves only (in Mumble: the local mute). Mute lights.
muted.title: Muted

volume.description:
The volume of the participant for the user, in percent, 0 to 200; the fader shows it. The daemon rounds it and
clamps it to 0..200.
volume.title: Volume

level.description:
How loud the participant talks, 0 to 1, after their volume: the peak since the line before. The meter shows it
with `meter_point = "post_fader"`. Leave it out if the client can't tell. The daemon clamps it to 0..1.
level.title: Level

pre_fader_level.description:
How loud the participant talks, 0 to 1, before their volume: the peak since the line before. The meter shows it
with `meter_point = "pre_fader"`, so it stays up while the fader is down. Without it, the meter shows `level`.
The daemon clamps it to 0..1.
pre_fader_level.title: Pre Fader Level

ParticipantState.title: ParticipantState

PluginState.description:
A line of the plugin: its whole state, on every change, and while someone talks for the levels (e.g. 20 times a
second).

protocol.description:
The version of the protocol that the plugin speaks. The daemon ignores (and logs) the lines of a version it does
not speak.
protocol.title: Protocol

client.description: The voice chat client, e.g. `mumble`: the log and the GUI name it.
client.title: Client

channel.description: The channel the user is in: the GUI shows it. Leave it out, or empty, outside a channel.
channel.title: Channel

capabilities.description:
What the plugin can do besides telling who is there and who talks: `volume` (the fader sets volumes), `mute`
(Mute mutes) and `levels` (it sends `level`, the meter shows it).
capabilities.title: Capabilities

participants.description: The participants in the channel of the user, without the user, in the order they came.
participants.title: Participants

PluginState.title: PluginState

Refusal.description: The only line of the daemon to a plugin that it refuses; the daemon closes the connection after it.

error.description:
Why the daemon refuses the plugin, e.g. `another mumble plugin is connected` while a plugin of the same client is
connected.
error.title: Error

Refusal.title: Refusal

SetMuted.description: A command of the daemon: mute or unmute a participant for the user. Needs the capability `mute`.

set_muted.description: The participant and their new mute.

SetMuted.title: SetMuted

SetVolume.description: A command of the daemon: set the volume of a participant. Needs the capability `volume`.

set_volume.description: The participant and their new volume.

SetVolume.title: SetVolume

VolumeChange.description: The volume a fader sets for a participant.

id.description: The `id` of the participant, as text.
id.title: Id

volume.description: The volume, in percent, 0 to 200. The plugin clamps a volume out of its range.
volume.title: Volume

VolumeChange.title: VolumeChange
